damana: Washka kʉntanaru wiwaga aga uka dugulumamba ingwi siej ãzhingamba.
Awananka gakwaga neka awãshkʉru akou nekwemdzi uragʉrga une ʉganeka.
Nawi dzhirra anzu angakurambaru Toguwa zhaginuka.
Toguamba kima dzhirra mʉn anzhʉnga anzu angakurra, kua zhama gakuaga kʉnzhu gakurra, meme name agʉni togua agʉn nukuakuaga nekʉnzhʉnga.
Washka aburu shka ãzhingʉmandzina ingwi ãsewa dumtua nanuka, ingwi aburu uragamba ukwiandzina avi kwaga kʉmʉna.
¿Washka aburu naka ʉ̃kʉgwana uwai ugwana awa kwaga nʉnka?
Shomaru kʉmawa kuagumʉnka nanuwashka anamisha atunga, aginru anzisi, kua ambʉntshi, kua aginru atshiki, aginru batatia ye kuega, kua aginru anzhuzhu kuega.
Sagaru sheku bo zhaktshika, sagaru dzhuiye ukunʉnka nʉnashka memaru sheku ukuka.
Sagaru zhandumaya nanunka, sagaru unzhu sanangui antenuka meme nane dzhuiga tuwa awashka meme bo zhaneka.
Zhinzhomaru anzizhega dunga, ekuiya dula ungashega, kua ekuiya go awega, pintando nekega.
Menaru terruwa angonekʉnka kʉskʉnkangui makumanka, menagaru duga unaka, menaru duzhi uragamba nukuanka terruwaga ankʉnguka.
Kʉ abunzhia duga kʉnʉnkaru abu kʉzhʉnga.
Wiwanzhe kʉsokuaru guarenia zhaginuka, guareniaru shimbʉn ba gogumanka, mema kima wiwanzhe kʉsokua, meme name wiwa kʉnzhʉnga garu guarenia zhiyushakuaga.
¿Nimba manzhe kʉsokua gogumanka ki biyunuka nanu?
Kʉ shka nekʉnzhʉngaru uma naikuaga, uma kima zha ekuiya kʉnzhʉnga netushishka, meme name umaru duma ankʉtuakuaga.
Akʉ duma ankʉtuwa aunkurreru, atʉna nekankurrashka ukuangui nukuankurraye.
Meme name zduwa zhakuaga, memeru uma mʉrrame arragubi ukuame.
¿Maka manzhe uma duma mʉnkatuka ki nanu?
¿Agʉni uma dunuwaye inzhina duma ankʉtuwakuaga ki nanu?
Kʉntanaru nawi shkaga gakurra, kantanaru terga aga maweru buna neka, anzhe teka aga mawenzhingua dukuan nukuakuaga, memeru mʉrrame kin jinunwaye.
Urragaru duma netuwanka dzhingoka, urragaru terruaga kin goka, arrata kua kʉnata izhipashka, memeru dzhiwa nekunwanshka kua dzhui bʉgui anzhanekunwanshka wi zhaneshi aukuame.
Kʉnru urraga nʉngawega iba aguigurra, kua nawinzhe Puente go agawega, kua bʉgui ekuiya awega dunga, meme name kʉn kʉminsha ta ta ta ta koshawinka.
Kʉnru wi zhanegashka se zhakutshika name kʉminsha koshawinka.
¿Ma ni awega nawa mʉkʉneka ki nanu?
¿Inzhue name kʉminsha kʉn koshawinka ki nanu?
Urramiru kʉnkʉnarga kuaga, urramiru gakuaga, sopamba inzhu gakuaga, urramiru dungʉrra ʉmʉktshi inuka, she tanaki zhameka kʉnʉnnarga, kua bo zhanekampanuwashka zhameka.
Ñameru nawiga gakurra, memaru zhama, irruguaye kuega nʉnashka memaru agʉni samnʉnka, memaru aga awamnʉnka ingui kʉgimba kuiya awakuaga.
Aga maunweru bʉgui zineka name memaru bʉgui agakuaga.
Shimaru tashimarga gunuka, shimaru garnanshe zhama, shimaru bʉgui sana antenuka, bʉgui zhaginuka sana antenuka.
Shkuaru amʉtshi, shkuaru atshiki, shkuaru tanki kuega.
Lemaru mʉzhʉnga, bʉgui lema sana nekʉnʉnka, ninzhe nanuwo, pakanzhe, ubejunzhe, purkunzhe, garnanzhe, wakanzhe, kua ninzhe nanuwo.
Sopamba inzhe gakuaga, kua gasha, kua mantekamba shusha.
Lema gairu dʉma mushakuaga name lema gakuaga, zhinzhoma mʉrrakin mʉkshenunwaye.
¿Ni sana lema agʉni mangaka ki nanu?
Misiru tshukui sozhanka gunuka, urragamba tshukui antenukuampanuwanshka misigaru gaka, kʉmisha antekubi ukuame, misiru duma tuwakuaga.
Zekuru zomarga gunuka, mema manganʉnkaru azhi tuwa mikutshakuaga name duma atuwakuaga, meme name kʉminsha guna ambunukamba mʉtsha mʉtsha nekawinka azhio bimsi ukuame.
Zuzhiru kʉnkʉnarga antenuka, zuzhigaru kʉmawa kin zhaga, kua malulu anekanka kin zhaga, zuzhiru bagui sana antenuka, shkuaru anzisi, kua amʉtshi, kua ambʉntshi, kua atshiki.
Zuzhi agina ipashawinka, kinzhatsha zhaneshi aukuame.
